chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz, from Ghiyāth, from Jaʿfar, from his father, peace be upon them both.
That he disliked that one enter the privy while having with him a white dirham, unless it is wrapped up.

key_terms.أَبْيَضُ: white, referring to a silver coin
key_terms.الْخَلَاءَ: the privy or place of relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to enter the toilet while carrying a coin in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is disliked to enter the privy while carrying a white dirham, unless it is wrapped or secured. It reflects an etiquette of maintaining respect for items associated with inscription or dignity in situations of impurity.
